I have been interested in this game since the first trailer came out. I prerecorded the game just to play it on day one, and when the game WORKS. It is one of the most exhilarating and fun experiences you can have in a competitive game. However the latency and bugs make this game totally unplayable. It baffles me how an update can break a game more rather than fixing the issues that have been present since the start. I love this game, but I cannot support a game that comes down to praying that the net code will favor me. Rather than how many matches I have played consecutively. For now I do not recommend this game, but once the devs fix the game and patch the numerous issues I will happily change my review and give more of my time to this game...

I launched Rematch and immediately realized that the football pitch is not just a field—it's the arena of existence. Each pass is a ripple in the fabric of the universe, each goal a manifestation of cosmic alignment. My character, once a mere avatar, became the embodiment of pure footballing energy, transcending the limitations of the game and the laws of physics.

The ball, a simple object in many games, here became a celestial orb, responding to my every command with divine precision. The opponents? Mere reflections of my own ego, challenging me to overcome my own limitations.

I sprinted across the field, not just in pursuit of victory, but in search of enlightenment. Each slide tackle was a lesson in humility, each successful dribble a step closer to self-realization.

The game's mechanics, once complex, now felt intuitive, as if the universe itself had conspired to make me the perfect footballer. The AI, once predictable, now adapted to my every move, pushing me to evolve and grow.

In the end, I didn't just win the match—I achieved a state of perfect harmony with the game, the players, and the universe itself.

10/10. Would transcend reality and score a bicycle kick into the cosmos again.

Rematch é um jogo fantástico para quem ama futebol e gosta de jogar com amigos. A jogabilidade é envolvente e estratégica, capturando a essência do desporto-rei de uma forma brilhante.

É perfeito para sessões de jogo com amigos, promovendo diversão e camaradagem. As partidas são intensas e memoráveis.

Para os que procuram um desafio, Rematch oferece profundidade tática e adversários que exigem o teu melhor. Cada jogo é uma oportunidade para aperfeiçoar as tuas habilidades e estratégias, tornando-o viciante e gratificante.

Adding features without think properly the full impacts on it. Short and long dive system will never work. At the moment you can be on side of one post, use long dive and reach the other post easily on a shot on the edge. BUT, if they nerf it, the gap between short and long will be almost null and therefore they will make the long dive useless and only short will be usable. To increase the skill depth for the keepers and to avoid minimap readers, a system with diving high and diving low would increase a lot of the skill depth of the game, minimap readers will be useless once they need to really see if the ball is going up and down.

tldr.text: Mixed (69%): players love the gameplay and combat, the most common praise.
The main complaint is bugs and crashes, raised in 21% of reviews, followed by unreliable servers and matchmaking.

details.text: Recent reviews are more positive, and bugs and crashes now appear in 7% of them, down from 21% overall.
Newcomers are the least positive group at 45%, while long-time players are less enthusiastic than those in the middle.
